labels.alt: alt_netting_possible: intervals where a masked cancellation / replenishment could hide (creation interval through the candidate interval, plus unexplained changes up to the candidate record hi); alt_first_addresses: every first-filler address the hard windows and the level life allow (conservative, may over-include)
labels.days: four consumed days: point estimates, no intervals (G = 4 < 5); QUEUE-FRONT v1 amendments 1-2 were adaptive consumed-day development
labels.economics: GROSS markouts from settle_ms; valid = chain_post_fill PNL cohort (status ok, not a self-trade, st_res valid, 1 s / 10 s / 60 s marks ok); inherited settlement-clock values, not values at an identified private match or posting decision; censoring and price / time composition are not matched
labels.front_win: a bound within the declared reconstruction scenario; unidentified unless no counted level carries alternative histories
labels.mechanism: creation_context = the anonymous cell-creation context associated with a candidate first filler
labels.occupancy: cell_occupied_at_window_lo / cell_empty_at_window_lo = the displayed size at the inferred posting-window lower endpoint, conditional on that window, with the post grade; never an actual-post queue label; population = top-3 orders that later filled
labels.roles: earliest_set = the earliest record(s) under the premise; later_same_hash = a later fill of an order hash of the earliest set (the same order: no queue loss shown); later_other = later fills of other hashes; "does the front pay?" withdrawn (contract 5.3)
labels.speed: speed_ms = the cell-event endpoint proxy with speed_lo_ms / speed_hi_ms; not a measured maker latency; endpoint ownership not assigned; no faster_than_others verdict
labels.status: front_candidate = the one-address earliest set under the no-netting premise; never certified (review finding 1)
labels.timing: book_candidate = the unique net decrease equal to the record quantity and claimed by no other record: a conditional timing candidate; an anonymous cancellation, replenishment or their netting inside a frame interval is not ruled out

null.design: v1's: within each market the maker labels of every attributed fill of the front_candidate levels permuted; the designated earliest fills keep their positions (a conditional label shuffle after selection)

readings.description: [scenario_lower, scenario_upper] is a bound within the declared reconstruction scenario (no-netting book candidates, one-address earliest sets), not a certified real-world bound; alt_* = the masked-netting first-filler sets over the same levels; fill share and p_hi over the attributed fills of front_candidate levels (a conditional label shuffle after selection, not an unconditional chance of winning a front)
